about: Kalyani Forge Ltd is a Pune- based precision-engineering company manufacturing hot, warm, and cold-forged, machined and assembled components. Its engine, driveline and axle products serve passenger /commercial vehicles, agriculture, industrial, power, off-highway, marine and EV applications. Its capabilities include heat treatment, die/tool making, testing and finishing. [1] [2]
